div.div:
The deployment strategy controls a Helm upgrade. It does not
control a node drain.
A cluster upgrade drains nodes. Without a PodDisruptionBudget,
a drain can stop every gateway pod at the same time, even with
three replicas and a correct strategy.
The chart does not make a PodDisruptionBudget. Write one.
Section 3.2 of the page gives it.
